invariant: sum(attribute_deltas) == 12 for every race. Race is the only source of net attribute gain at creation.
skill_rule: Skill bonuses set the named skills to their listed value if currently lower (base 5).

not_playable.altmer: A race earns a row in the reaction matrix only if enough NPCs in 3E 427 Black Marsh have an opinion about it to fill one. Altmer presence in the province is a handful of Mages Guild scholars; the honest row would be ten zeroes. RI-CHR02 §1.

races.name: Saxhleel

abilities.name: Amphibious
abilities.effect: Unlimited water breathing; no swim stamina drain; stand and act in deep water.

abilities.name: Root-listener
abilities.effect: Sapwell rests cost 0 taint and yield one Hist line per new well.

races.writ_line: Saxhleel. Marsh-form. The scribe does not write this down; she writes down that she did not have to ask.

races.name: Naga

abilities.name: Amphibious
abilities.effect: Unlimited water breathing; no swim stamina drain; stand and act in deep water.

abilities.name: Shed
abilities.effect: Break out of grapple, paralysis or bind and gain 3 s of poise immunity.

races.writ_line: Naga. She writes the form down twice, and looks at the door once while she does it.

races.name: Dunmer

abilities.name: Ancestor Guardian
abilities.effect: Summon a spirit that fights for 30 s.

races.writ_line: Dunmer. She writes it, then puts the pen down, then picks it up again.

races.name: Imperial
races.amended_by: AMENDMENT-W1-07-01 — PER +4 -> +5; the original row summed to 11 and failed RI-CHR02 method 1.

abilities.name: Star of the West
abilities.effect: Absorb 30 stamina from a target. Out of combat only — an intimidation tool, not a fight tool.

races.writ_line: Imperial. She writes it in the same hand as the rest of the page, which is the only courtesy in the room.

races.name: Nord

abilities.name: Thunder Fist
abilities.effect: 60 shock damage on the next connecting hit.

races.writ_line: Nord. She asks how long you intend to stay, and writes down whatever you say without believing it.

races.name: Breton
races.resistance_note: Magic 50% applies to ALL schools, including your own spells.
races.writ_line: Breton. She asks whether you are with the Guild. She does not write the answer.

races.name: Redguard
races.writ_line: Redguard. She writes it and asks nothing else, which for a Redguard in this office is unusual and you will find out why.

races.name: Khajiit
races.writ_line: Khajiit. She writes the word and then a second word after it, in a smaller hand, and turns the page before you can read it.

races.name: Orsimer

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.effect: 30 s of +30% melee damage and -30% damage resistance.

races.writ_line: Orsimer. She writes 'Orc' and then crosses it out and writes 'Orsimer', which is either respect or the ledger's rules.

races.name: Bosmer

abilities.name: Beast Tongue
abilities.effect: Calm one beast-archetype enemy for 60 s. A real S13 non-lethal exit against the roster's animals, which have no parley.

races.writ_line: Bosmer. She asks if you have been to Blackwood. Everyone asks a Bosmer that.

non_combat_abilities_note: Two abilities are deliberately non-combat (Star of the West, Night Eye / Land on Your Feet) and one is deliberately anti-combat (Beast Tongue). RI-CHR02 §1; mirrors RI-PRG02's rule that not every line on the sheet may be a damage line.
